XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay Classroom Training — replaces BizLMS local_classroom

FIELD.NAME: shortname
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032: BizLMS short name. Filled by the classroom importer, not by the edit form

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant org ID

FIELD.NAME: trainerid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id — primary trainer

FIELD.NAME: locationid
FIELD.COMMENT: Phase 5 A.5: local_sentientia_locations.id. Added by step 2026051160; declared here 2026-09-25 (step 2026092501 adds it where missing)

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=active, 0=cancelled, 2=completed, 5=draft, 6=on hold (5 and 6 added by ADR-032: BizLMS had both states; 3 and 4 are never used because BizLMS used them for other meanings)

FIELD.NAME: startdate
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 batch (2026-05-16): UNIX ts — classroom becomes enrollable on this date

FIELD.NAME: enddate
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 batch (2026-05-16): UNIX ts — classroom closes for new enrolments on this date

FIELD.NAME: trainingstart
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032: UNIX ts, first day the classroom runs (BizLMS startdate). startdate and enddate stay the enrolment window

FIELD.NAME: trainingend
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032: UNIX ts, last day the classroom runs (BizLMS enddate)

FIELD.NAME: timecompleted
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032: UNIX ts, when BizLMS recorded the classroom as completed

FIELD.NAME: createdby
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032: FK to mdl_user.id, the user who created the classroom in BizLMS

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_classroom_trainers
TABLE.COMMENT: ADR-032: every trainer of a classroom (BizLMS local_classroom_trainers). The primary trainer is also local_sentientia_classroom.trainerid. Created by upgrade step 2026093002; must stay identical to db/upgradelib.php.

FIELD.NAME: trainerid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id, a trainer of the classroom

INDEX.NAME: idx_classroom_trainer
INDEX.COMMENT: A user is a trainer of a classroom once

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_classroom_courses
TABLE.COMMENT: ADR-032: the courses linked to a classroom (BizLMS local_classroom_courses). Created by upgrade step 2026093002; must stay identical to db/upgradelib.php.

INDEX.NAME: idx_classroom_course
INDEX.COMMENT: A course is linked to a classroom once

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional session title (e.g. 'Day 2 — Hands-on lab')

FIELD.NAME: sessiondate
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp

FIELD.NAME: locationid
FIELD.COMMENT: Phase 5 A.5: local_sentientia_locations.id. Added by step 2026051160; declared here 2026-09-25 (step 2026092501 adds it where missing)

FIELD.NAME: trainerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Override classroom trainer for this specific session

FIELD.NAME: meeting_url
FIELD.COMMENT: W1-7: live meeting URL (Zoom/Teams/Webex/Meet)

FIELD.NAME: recording_url
FIELD.COMMENT: W1-7: post-session recording URL

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_classroom_users
TABLE.COMMENT: Roster: users enrolled in a classroom (precondition for attendance)

FIELD.NAME: enrolledby
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id — admin who added them

FIELD.NAME: completion_status
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032: 0=pending, 1=completed (BizLMS completion_status). Imported history; nothing in Sentientia sets it yet

FIELD.NAME: timecompleted
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032: UNIX ts, when the learner completed the classroom. Only set when completion_status is 1

FIELD.NAME: hours
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032: hours BizLMS credited to the learner for this classroom

INDEX.NAME: idx_classroom_user
INDEX.COMMENT: A user can only be enrolled once per classroom

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=absent, 1=present, 2=late, 3=excused

FIELD.NAME: markedby
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id — admin who marked it

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_classroom_waitlist
TABLE.COMMENT: Waiting list for a full classroom. Created by upgrade step 2026051130; declared here 2026-09-24 so a fresh install has it too, and step 2026092400 adds it where missing. Must stay identical to both steps.

FIELD.NAME: position
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = head of the queue; renumbered 1..N over the waiting rows

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: waiting, promoted or removed

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why the row was removed: user left, or an admin free-text reason

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_locations
TABLE.COMMENT: Phase 5 A.5 (ENTERPRISE-GRADE-PLAN.md): training venues for classroom sessions. Created by upgrade step 2026051160; declared here 2026-09-25 so a fresh install has it too, and step 2026092501 adds it where missing. Must stay identical to db/upgradelib.php.

FIELD.NAME: latitude
FIELD.COMMENT: Decimal degrees, NUMBER(10,6). Step 2026051160 created it NUMBER(10,0) until 2026-09-25

FIELD.NAME: longitude
FIELD.COMMENT: Decimal degrees, NUMBER(10,6). Step 2026051160 created it NUMBER(10,0) until 2026-09-25

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant org ID

FIELD.NAME: parentid
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032: a room points at its institute (another row of this table). NULL for an institute or a venue with no parent

FIELD.NAME: venue_type
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032: 1=internal, 2=external (BizLMS institute_type). NULL when unknown

FIELD.NAME: building
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032: building of a room (BizLMS local_location_room.building)
